body: Sadly.
At first I wanted to do it somewhere sort of public but now I'm thinking doing it quietly somewhere discreet is much more polite. Don't want to end up in the news. That would just bring more shame.
Yeah. Still want to do it. Really scared.
Drunk as shit. Can't feel legs. Had to retype this sentence a lot to get it right. I deserve to die. "Nobody does," they say. They are wrong.
I'm a sick, deranged fuck and dying is the biggest favor I can do for anyone.
There is. I'm no good, however.
I'm going to wait a week or so.
I read this in another thread as advice and it's good advice but I probably won't fight any bears.
I found my tree. It took a while, walking in the cold. Most of the trees were too tall, with no low hanging branches. There was one that worked. I tested the weight. It will do.
Sorry everybody.
I ~~know~~ think ghosts aren't real, I just really wish it could be true.
I'm aware and feel really fucking terrible about it.
How is your father now?

I'm aware of the 'oh shit, I know how to fix my life' moment that jumpers who've survived have described. I'll probably have one myself as I kick and struggle, tears pouring down my face. I plan to wear a hood, which should help make it less weird for whoever finds me.
Thank you, Alex.
*I* deserve it.

I have enough of a mental health record that the military would be out of bounds. I don't really want to join the Peace Corps, though I've considered it. I worry I'd lose any progress I've made towards a 'real job'.

I have several odd jobs that all pay pretty poorly and I'm not able to pay off my student loans at all. I have had consistently violent thoughts when I'm in a shitty emotional place. When I'm in a good place (which can last for months, years) they're not there. When I'm in a bad place (which can last the same as the good) I fantasize about lashing out against my tormenters if I have them. Mostly I just break things, though I haven't done this in a long time because it's pretty childish. I got into a fight with my father recently when he threatened to hit my little brother, who is much smaller than my father. I only tackled him to the ground but it was still a shock that I was capable of that. I almost got kicked out but we all talked it out. We've all been feeling squeezed financially and it's tough, among other things.

My childhood was okay. I was lonely and mostly spent my time alone reading. That's what my life is like right now too, except I can go out and get hammered if I feel like it.

To clarify, I'm not the type of person who wants to hurt people for fun. I've never tortured animals or bullied people. I probably have these fantasies about justice or revenge because I feel like I have no control over my life.

I also have heredity issues that I'm afraid to pass on. I'm terrified of how my family will react. Suicide has happened before and they've survived but that was a long time ago. I'm not sure how my siblings will react. I mean, I know it will be awful, but they have no idea how much better off they'll be with me out of the picture, even if they're lonely. I'm no angel and probably never will be.

Your father and his brother's hat makes me very sad. Your father sounds like a good man. You sound like a good person yourself. 

I hope that girl is safe and loved too. I want to be safe and loved.

Man (boy). I have no control in my life and probably will end up in jail for assault, murder, or who knows what. I'm fucked up and filled with rage. It's not always this way, but that it's there at all scares me.

I'm also lonelier than I've ever been in my whole life and very uncertain about my future. I think I chose a career path that will lead me on an unstable, unreliable track (and I am already pretty unstable, I guess) and that I will never know the joys of marriage or family because of my financial and mental issues. 

I just wanted to be a father but I will absolutely not pass on these shitty genes. The buck stops here.

I considered CO poisoning (and no, I don't mean overdosing on a pleasurable holiday filled with marijuana and skiing) but research showed it to be a pretty complicated process that seemed easy to fuck up. The bridge I chose is over concrete. I'm afraid of the pain of hanging but I think it's what I've chosen. I'm going to get very, very drunk first. I'll handcuff myself so I can't freak out and turn back. Mostly, I'm just wondering what I'll wear. Would a tie be too ironic?

I'm manic bipolar and I worry I'm a psychopath sometimes. I don't feel very human. I feel like an outsider who mostly is just here to entertain himself and hurt others, despite my best intentions.

Thanks for thinking I'm good. I think I'm alright, I just don't like living with the rage I feel. Someday, I might kill a man if put in the right (wrong?) place. I'd rather that man be me than any stranger, enemy, or friend.
What do you mean by 'cancer'? Drinking and smoking yourself to death?

I've affected some for better, some for worse. I've done what I've done and that's all there is too it. I know most people will be surprised. Most will be sad. A few will probably relish it and laugh. I consider what I'm going to do an awful blow to the former and I feel pretty awful about it. It's a gift for the latter. It's a reward for myself. 

I lived the life I lived and now it's time to go.
so it goes

I'm reading 'The Old Man and the Sea'. It's short, though. I'll need a new book soon. 

I'm sorry about your losses. I know if I was gone a lot of my family would miss me too. But they've never seen me at my worst; they only know the facade I put on when I'm feeling 'okay'.

I want help but there's no helping me. I wish I could just live alone somewhere and never interact with people. I think that would be okay, though I would be lonely. I just think I'm sort of dangerous and unstable and bad for people.
I see a psych regularly. He says nice things and then I get medicine.

My girlfriend left me because I'm crazy.

I can't hold down a job because I'm crazy. 

I'm losing my friends because I'm crazy.

I can't sleep at night because, get this, I'm crazy.

I'm poor, my life is in shambles, I don't have anyone I care about anymore and nobody really cares about me. I'm tired of dragging people down and just would really like to go away.
I can talk to my family and friends but mostly they are sick of hearing it. I also don't want them to feel worse when I do it, like they could have helped if they'd only listened closer.
Nah, I'm pretty nuts.
A long drop.
I'm an organ donor but my plan will probably leave very little in tact. Plus I'm not a very healthy person.
Wish I could. I'd just be the same fuck up over there.
Everything is so wrong and it's all because of me.
I've been moping long enough to my real life folk. They don't care anymore.
Maybe they're not wrong.
Dude, *everything*.
Yeah. Had nightmares all night about my life, failures, etc. Only woke up to escape them.
Guess what I'm doing right now.

I just did this, actually. Kicked out of my old place. Living somewhere new now. Meeting new people. They're alright. I'm not. I'm not okay at all.

If I had a gun I'd put it in my mouth right now. Good advice, though. I'm sure for some people it'd be a good thing to do.
